title: month_year accepts non-canonical month strings ("2023-6", "2023-006"), breaking the documented YYYY-MM draft contract and bypassing the to-before-from guard
location: server/src/reference_checks/questions.gleam:889-916 (month_year); bypass lands in validate_month_year at questions.gleam:450-478
detail: Only year_str length is checked, never month_str length. "2023-6" passes and is stored, violating the documented draft shape {"from":"YYYY-MM"}. Non-padded months also break the ordering guard: string.compare("2023-10", "2023-6") is Lt, so a tenancy from 2023-10 to 2023-6 (ends 4 months before it starts) is accepted. Chunk test tenancy_period_rejects_malformed_month_test only pins "June 2023", leaving this path unhandled. rc3-4's structurer consumes these shapes.
recommended_fix: Add string.length(month_str) == 2 to the month_year guard so only zero-padded YYYY-MM passes; pin "2023-6" and "2023-006" as Invalid in tenancy_period_rejects_malformed_month_test.

title: euro_amount accepts "+1400" and "0001400", storing non-canonical amount_eur strings that the review screen renders as "€+1400"/"€001400"
detail: int.parse (Erlang binary_to_integer) accepts a leading '+', and the length/digit checks do not exclude zero-padding, so "+1400" and "0001400" validate and are stored verbatim. The review summary concatenates "€" <> value (questions.gleam answer_summary AmountOrDontRemember), rendering "€+1400". The chunk's rent_amount_rejects_non_numeric_test pins only "1,400".
recommended_fix: Reject values whose parsed digits differ from the raw string (e.g. check int.to_string(n) == value before Ok), or normalize to canonical digits before storing.
